state.paragraph: Between August 6, 2013 and August 27, 2013, the four bidders conducted business and legal due diligence. During this time, Party B and Party C, in light of the fact that they were financial bidders, were given broad access to an electronic data site, and Party A and CSC/Pamplona, in light of the fact that they were strategic bidders, were given somewhat limited access to this electronic data site, with access to customer data, including customer locations, being reserved until later in the process as part of the staging discussed at the July 25 th Special Committee meeting. During this time, both Party A and CSC/Pamplona participated in discussions with members of Mac-Gray management around synergies.
state.target_sentence: During this time, both Party A and CSC/Pamplona participated in discussions with members of Mac-Gray management around synergies.

criteria.row_27: 08/06/2013 to 08/27/2013 | Mac-Gray | Other material event | Information access differs by bidder type: B and C (financial) get broad data-room access; A and CSC/Pamplona (strategic) get limited access, customer data withheld, plus synergy talks. All four had management presentations 08/06-08/14.
criteria.row_28: 08/27/2013 | Mac-Gray (BofA Merrill Lynch) | Deadline set | Letter to all four (authorized 08/15): revised written proposals due 09/09/2013 to go on to in-depth evaluation. Proposals to cover valuation, financing, approvals, covenants and diligence.
criteria.row_29: 09/09/2013 | CSC/Pamplona | Bid | price 19.5 | Revised IOI, up from $18.50 (#18). Pamplona commits 100% of the capital. Requests 2-week exclusivity. Heavy: customer data still withheld and further in-depth diligence expected.
criteria.row_30: 09/09/2013 | Party B | Bid | price 18.5 | Revised IOI, up from $17.00-$18.00 (#21). Financing from affiliated-fund equity plus third-party debt; no firm financing commitment (Heavy).
criteria.row_31: 09/09/2013 | Mac-Gray | Deadline | Due date for revised written proposals. CSC/Pamplona and Party B bid on time; Party A and Party C bid on 09/10 and were reviewed on 09/11 (late bids accepted).
criteria.none: None of the ledger rows records the event reported in the target sentence, either as the row's own event or in its note.
criteria.not_an_event: The target sentence reports no discrete event of these kinds (background, reasoning, description or discussion only).

match.instructions: `target_sentence` (from a merger filing; `paragraph` gives context) appears to report that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Each option describes one row of a research ledger as date | party | event | note. Select the row that records the event reported in `target_sentence`: same party or group, same action, consistent date and terms, allowing paraphrase and allowing the event to be summarised in a row's note. A related event with a different party, date or action does not count.
